name: Bewitchments and Glamours
summary: The Ironforge library seeks magical works to add to its collection. You can help its knowledge grow by bringing in books that may benefit the library.

sections.title: A Growing Collection
sections.body: The library asks you to bring in magical works that may benefit its collection. Each addition broadens what its keepers know.

faq.answer: The library seeks magical works that could benefit its collection.

faq.q: Where do I bring the magical works?
faq.answer: Bring them to the library in Ironforge.

faq.q: Why are they collecting magical works?
faq.answer: The library says the works will expand its knowledge.
